messages:
June: quick RN drop for tomorrow's push. Need pin for model-server v2.3.2 and a short 09:30 PT stage-gate. Can someone take pin + announce?
Omar: I can pin. Suggest label `v2.3.2-rn-2024-06c`.
Riley: I'll run deploybot. Rollout cadence suggestion: dry-run -> canary 4% 6m -> 30% 8m -> 100%. Rollback: revert to v2.3.1 and flip 'tokenizer_experimental' off.
June: added rollback snippet + alert thresholds to RN. Preview: https://redwood.internal/rn/1729999999 (internal)
SRE Oncall: reserving 09:20-10:00 PT. Alert rule: 5xx >= 1% for 3m OR p95 > 350ms => notify #incident-deploy.
deploy-bot: queued job 88001 | env=prod | image=model-server:v2.3.2 | strategy=canary(4%,6m)->30%(8m)->100% | requested_by=Riley | pin_label=v2.3.2-rn-2024-06c
Riley: running dry-run at 09:25. If green, announce at 09:28 and start at 09:30.
Omar: PR looks good. Please pin RN in #eng-releases after announce and update CHANGELOG with the pin.
deploy-bot: job 88001 dry-run passed at 09:26. Ready for scheduled rollout.
Riley: posting internal announce at 09:28: "Starting canary rollout for model-server v2.3.2 at 09:30 PT. Standby: @SRE Oncall @Omar @Riley."
June: confirming KV-cache warmup step included in RN.
SRE Oncall: watching metrics. If we hit thresholds we'll open incident channel.
deploy-bot: job 88001 status: canary(4%) started at 09:30.
Riley: initial 3m looks fine, continuing to 30%.
deploy-bot: job 88001 status: canary(30%) started at 09:37.
SRE Oncall: all green, proceeding to 100% unless anyone objects.
Riley: proceeding to 100%.
deploy-bot: job 88001 status: 100% started at 09:46. job 88001 status: success at 09:50.
June: RN finalized, pinned, changelog updated. Thanks team. Closing thread.
